newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motors says erases units' accumulated loss.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motors says erases units' accumulated loss.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp (MMC) said on Wednesday that it had erased $1.7 billion worth of accumulated losses at two of its subsidiaries in the United States.
A company spokesman also said that the Japanese car maker's group current profit in the year to March 31, 1998, would be larger than the 9.52 billion yen it posted in 1996/97.
MMC injected funds into the units while the units drastically reduced their capital, wiping away the losses, the spokesman said.
The Japanese car maker decided to make fresh investments because it believed that its business in the United States was now improving, he said.
The move is expected to boost MMC's group current profit, he said.
In May, MMC said its 1997/98 group net profit would be about 11.5 billion yen, unchanged from 1996/97, and the spokesman said that MMC would maintain the outlook for group net profit.
The company did not reveal its group current profit forecast for 1997/98 in May.
